thread:
remy: incoming LoRA from Lighthouse (v1). Merged locally and seeing token alignment issues on enumerate/date parsing. QA paused.

nora: can you paste a short repro?

remy: sure:
```
Prompt: "What are the steps to onboard a device?"
Gold: "1) Register device
2) Approve cert
3) Deploy config"
Merged: "1) Register device\n2) Approve cert\n3) Deploy config\n\n"  <-- extra newline token at end
```

jake: that extra newline often means special token ordering mismatch. Check lora meta for tokenizer and specials.

remy: lora_meta.json shows `"tokenizer": "sentencepiece"` while our serving models use `redwood-b1-bpe`.

nora: we should remap special tokens explicitly before merging. We have `scripts/remap_specials.py` but it's not in the default pipeline.

remy: ran remap then re-merge. token shift ratio dropped from 0.012 -> 0.003 (1.2% -> 0.3%). Good but still want a gate.

ops-bot: quick-eval started job=11899 logs=https://ci.redwood/jobs/11899/logs

jake: note: int4 quant showed larger diffs in past runs. Run comparisons on fp16/int8/int4. Use `--quant int8` as default for new customer merges.

remy: eval command used:
```
./bin/run_quick_eval --model artifacts/lighthouse/merged --prompts evals/lighthouse_smoke_120.json --quant int8 --out /tmp/lh_eval_int8.json
```

remy: results: fp16 acc 0.76, int8 0.75, int4 0.67. Most deltas around punctuation and list tokens.

nora: proposal: 1) add `check_token_shift.py` to pre-merge CI that computes token_shift_ratio; 2) auto-insert special-token remap step when metadata.tokenizer != model.tokenizer; 3) set default quant to int8 for new customer artifacts until int4 kernel validation passes.

jake: +1. Suggest CI thresholds: fail if >1.0%, warn if between 0.5%-1.0% (open triage). For high-sensitivity customers, lower warn->fail to 0.5%.

remy: I'll open a PR with remap + CI hook + docs snippet for SEs requesting original tokenizer/vocab from customers. ETA: 24h.

nora: also add a short note to onboarding playbook: if customer used sentencepiece provide model or mapping file to avoid iterative remaps.

remy: pinging when PR is up and when follow-up evals complete. :white_check_mark:
